correctness.rationale: Carry recursion q'=floor((q+b)/2), digit d=(q+b) mod 2, trailing-one cap a and occurrence parity p tracks all output. Residual F_{q,a,p}(z)=p+s_m(z+q)+χ_m(a,ν2(z+q+1)) distinguishes equal q by parity and suitably chosen trailing-one counts. For distinct q, continuation z=2^K-q' yields oscillatory output from q versus constant from q', preventing merges. Reachable positive carry levels and zero-carry 2m states yield N_m(r)=2m+Σ_{k=0}^r A_m(k)+1_{r=m}. An independent full partition-refinement minimization checked 60 (m,r) pairs and exact direct outputs; all-size conclusion rests on residual proof.
